constitutional_basis: Article XXVII (no threshold invention) — every operational threshold applied by the R441 Visual Compiler carries its measurement basis, context and uncertainty. Revised values are APPENDED to the revision history, never overwritten.

memory_guard_mb.basis: MEASURED (2026-09-10, sandbox verification host, R441 acceptance): headless Chromium + SwiftShader renderer tree peak PSS 542-643 MB across 8 processes (chrome-gpu SwiftShader ~393 MB dominant, node ~98 MB, chrome mains ~152 MB; measured per-process from /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup during live R441 acceptance runs over two CAD GLBs at 1536x1024 with the full seven-view set). The guard values (800 in-worker / 650 async) sit ABOVE the measured tree peak with a modest margin. CONSEQUENCE (same honest production behavior as the Blender path): on the 512 MB Starter cgroup the visual compiler TYPED-SKIPS (RENDER_SKIPPED_LOW_MEMORY, Art. LXI) with the plan-upgrade note; on a >=1 GB plan it renders automatically. The Blender comparison baseline (~269 MB RSS trivial scene) is NOT directly comparable — Cycles path tracing vs SwiftShader rasterization with persistent GPU-process surfaces.
memory_guard_mb.uncertainty: PSS sum double-counts nothing (proportional), but varies with model complexity, resolution and view count by roughly +/-15%; the largest single process (SwiftShader GPU) dominates. Re-measure on the production plan before lowering.

chrome_baseline_measurement.environment: sandbox verification host (R441 acceptance), chrome-headless-shell 152.0.7977.54 via puppeteer-core 25.9.0, three 0.175.0, Node v24
chrome_baseline_measurement.notes: antialias disabled for the deterministic raster path (SwiftShader MSAA buffers ~4x surface memory; the interactive website viewer keeps its own AA). Turntable rendered at half resolution (768x512) — gallery asset, not the hero.

render_budget_seconds.basis: the full seven-view visual set (hero + 12-frame turntable + exploded + section + 4 orthographic + dimension + poster + 2 GLB exports) through SwiftShader CPU rasterization measured at 6.9-17.1 s live — the 480 s budget is >25x the measured worst case, generous by construction. Env-overridable via ENGINE_VC_TIMEOUT_S.

quality_contract.note: rasterization (Three.js) has no Cycles 'samples' — the R420 quality ladder's samples dimension is N/A by engine change and recorded as such in the typed record; the ladder's resolution/budget dimensions carry over.

revision_history.change: initial record — thresholds carried over from the Blender provenance file where engine-independent, fresh where engine-specific; chrome baseline marked TO_BE_MEASURED

chrome baseline MEASURED on live acceptance runs (542-643 MB tree PSS, breakdown recorded); memory guards set to 800 in-worker / 650 async per the measurement (was 650/400 carried from Blender); antialias disabled on the renderer path with rationale; turntable pinned at half resolution; budgets confirmed against measured 6.9-17.1 s wall times
